title: PGA Native Development
summary: Explore imported original course geometry in the visual lab, or play the generated native practice holes. PGA Tour 2005 gameplay and presentation fidelity remain in development.
notes: This is an original native development prototype. It is not Tiger Woods PGA Tour 2005, a verified port, or a byte-identical recreation.

Original course geometry and selected original textures are available in the course lab. Playable practice uses generated test holes. Original characters, animation, sound, modes, and exact game rules remain unreconstructed.
Fullscreen targets a 2560 × 1600 Metal render surface. The HUD reports the actual render dimensions; windowed play follows the Retina drawable.

Keyboard and trackpad are available. Standard gamepads use macOS extended profiles. The XB1 Fusion Pro has no macOS profile, so an in-app native USB adapter now receives its input reports; physical bindings still need validation.
keyboard: Left / Right or A / D: aim. Up / Down or W / S: choose club. H: aim at pin.
Space / Return or click: start swing, set power, set accuracy. Drag horizontally: aim. Scroll: zoom.
C: switch camera. Escape: cancel swing, then pause. R: restart hole while stationary or paused. F: fullscreen.
Use Return to Library in the HUD or pause screen to leave the prototype.
Pause menu: open Original course lab to inspect imported source meshes and textures; its HUD shows viewer controls.
controller: Standard macOS extended gamepad profiles and the native XB1 Fusion Pro USB adapter are supported paths. Physical bindings still need validation.
A: swing / resume / advance. Left stick or D-pad left/right: aim. LB / RB or D-pad up/down: choose club.
Y: aim at pin (when paused: restart hole). X: switch camera. Right stick up/down: zoom. B: cancel / pause. Menu: pause.
Menu / B opens pause. D-pad or left stick up/down selects Resume, Restart hole, Restart round, Original course lab, or Return hub; A confirms.
Course lab: sticks orbit / pan, LT / RT zoom, LB / RB change course, X switches palette, Y resets view, B returns to practice, Menu returns to hub.
